issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change; conventions require tests for every feature plus unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Entity creation writes via DB::transaction inline in the Livewire component instead of an app/Actions/* use-case class that authorizes inside the action.
Dashboard route uses custom current_entity middleware but it is never registered with Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so Livewire update requests skip the tenant check.
Session-membership checks use direct membershipFor plus abort(403) in middleware and entity.pick instead of going through EntityPolicy via Gate/authorize.
Single-membership /home path does not handle a soft-deleted entity: Entity::find can return null and then redirect()->route uses a null entity.
Navbar calls auth()->user()->memberships()->count() unguarded and on every render, repeating a query and risking null for guests.

conventions.evidence: Follows #[Validate]+validate, policies for Livewire actions, $fillable, Blade components, docs+CHANGELOG; deviations: no app/Actions/* for CreateEntity write (CreateEntity.php:134), no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for current_entity (bootstrap/app.php:585)

readability.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:57, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:498, app/Http/Middleware/ResolveCurrentEntity.php:37: clear names, small focused methods, no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: Migrations entities_slug_unique/entity_memberships_entity_user_unique/entity_memberships_one_owner with owner_seq storedAs; Entity/UserRole/policies/factories/routes/lang keys; CreateEntity uniqueSlug retry loop + audit log + session+redirect; Dashboard authorize view; switcher button classes + data-current

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves onboarding/session/switcher/dashboard/schema/docs/CHANGELOG; no members/settings pages, locale middleware, dropdown redesign, or other out-of-scope work

security.evidence: CreateEntity.php:120-122 validate+authorize create with hardcoded Owner role; Dashboard.php:21 authorize view; entity.pick checks membership before touching session; {{ $entity->name }} escaping; gap: current_entity not persistent for Livewire updates

simplicity.evidence: Lean Tenant helper (app/Support/Tenant.php:1-25), reuses layouts::default-page/x-form-field/x-button, minimal suffix slug loop; only small /home-vs-middleware dispatch duplication

tests.evidence: change.diff contains zero tests/ paths and zero *Test.php files; no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call, or tamper tests

review.summary: Implements the full entities data model, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding, switcher, dashboard, and docs correctly. Blocked by zero shipped tests, a missing app/Actions/* extraction, and missing Livewire persistent middleware, so it needs substantial rework before merging.
